name: MAC Mobility | AC <-> PW Single Move (real PE path)
infra_detail: Uses the same real, passed topology as TEST_mac_mob_basic_SW205160: PE-4 local untagged AC ge100-18/0/1 and RR-SA-2 remote AC bundle-100.2001, both in EVPN_SI_VPLS_1. The same source MAC is first learned locally on PE-4, then moved to RR-SA-2 so PE-4 sees it via VPLS PW (v>), then moved back to PE-4 local AC (L>). No synthetic Spirent VPLS peer and no guessed VLAN flags are allowed.
rewrite_rationale: The legacy ac_pw recipe uses a synthetic Spirent VPLS peer and MPLS vpls-stream path. That remains valid for the spirent_vpls_cp infrastructure mode, but it is not the next accurate real-topology regression derived from the passed 2026-05-01 run.
This recipe tests true AC<->PW mobility using the real PE-4 <-> RR-SA-2 service path proven by basic_learning SC01 and SC03.
Move scenarios explicitly preserve the prior MAC source state before trigger; clearing the MAC before a move would turn the scenario into fresh learning and invalidate the test.
All Spirent flags are copied from teach-plan-backed expected_traffic entries and revalidated at RUN prerequisite time through strict mcp_dnaas_teach_plan checks.

service_capabilities.rationale: EVPN_SI_VPLS_1 is the passed shared service where PE-4 owns the local AC and RR-SA-2 is the VPLS PW peer. PE-4 must have both native EVPN RT and VPLS-SI RT so Local->PW withdraw and PW->Local advertise can be observed.

L.label: L> Local AC source on PE-4 untagged port-mode AC
L.frame_recipe_source: dnos_dnaas_teach_plan(vlan=211, dut=YOR_CL_PE-4, test_mac={test_mac}) MUST return encap='untagged'

v.label: v> VPLS PW source via RR-SA-2 AC -> PW -> PE-4
v.frame_recipe_source: dnos_dnaas_teach_plan(vlan=215, dut=RR-SA-2, test_mac={test_mac}, inner_vlan=3001) MUST return encap='double-tagged'
v.pw_proof_command: show evpn instance EVPN_SI_VPLS_1 vpls-pw | no-more

prerequisites.rationale: Local side of AC<->PW move must be PE-4 ge100-18/0/1, the passed untagged port-mode AC.
PW side of the move must be the real RR-SA-2 PW peer, not a synthetic Spirent VPLS peer.

traffic_config.note: Low-rate single-MAC streams isolate source transitions and avoid DNAAS rate noise.

verdict.scenario_pass_definition: SC01 proves initial L> source, SC02 preserves that state and moves to v>, SC03 preserves v> state and moves back to L>. Any failed source-qualified assertion after traffic proof invokes Bug Finding Guard.

infrastructure_correct_checklist: SC01 starts from a clean MAC and proves PE-4 local AC RX plus L> source.
SC02 uses cleanup_scope=preserve so Local->PW is a real move, not fresh PW learning.
SC03 uses cleanup_scope=preserve so PW->Local is a real move, not fresh local learning.
Spirent streams use only the flags from expected_traffic.L or expected_traffic.v after strict mcp_dnaas_teach_plan prerequisites pass.
Verifier uses source-qualified DNOS state (L> / v>) and RT-2 presence/absence, not generic Spirent TX counters.
